global: This ramen features a rich, golden broth, topped with chashu pork, nori, menma, and a naruto fish cake, arranged neatly in a blue-and-white patterned bowl. Soft lighting highlights the steam rising from the bowl, set against a warm wooden table.

regions.background: Light brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, forming a circular boundary around the bowl.
regions.bowl: Blue and white ceramic bowl with intricate floral pattern and raised rim, glossy finish.
regions.soup: Golden broth with yellow noodles, glossy surface, visible green onions, and scattered toppings.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, rectangular, with a rough, textured surface and visible crispy edges.
regions.meat: The chashu pork slice shows pinkish meat, seasoned with black pepper, and has a slightly uneven, tender texture.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, with fibrous texture and irregular, slightly curled shapes, showing glossy surface from broth.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: round, pale pink swirl center, creamy white edges, slightly textured surface.
